seo.title: The DOM VIRUS arcade is open: six free browser games
seo.description: Six free browser games by Chris Cooley: four play right on the page, two Battlefield tank games run full screen. No install, open source (MIT).

sections.heading: The DOM VIRUS arcade is open
sections.headingAccent: Six free games that play on the page.
sections.body: DOM VIRUS is open: an arcade of six free browser games by Chris Cooley. Four play right on the page you are reading and turn its letters and buttons into the game board. Two Battlefield tank games run full screen on their own sites. No install, no account, and every game is open source (MIT).

items.title: Sherman Bytes
items.body: Drive a pixel tank across the page: breach the button bases, build cover and hold the page against siege waves.

items.title: Swarm Protocol
items.body: Bugs eat the letters into binary and drain your buttons. Squash them before the interface falls apart.

items.title: Byte Runner
items.body: A pixel frog races food pipes in the page's whitespace, eats the real text and hunts the flies.

items.title: Null Invaders
items.body: Fly an interceptor through the page, shoot letters into binary and break the button factories over four waves.

sections.heading: Board games

items.title: DOM Battlefield
items.body: Squad tactics: freeze time to plan every route for up to twelve tanks, then command them under fire.

items.title: Battlefield Blitz
items.body: The arcade version: parachute in, call airstrikes, most kills in three minutes wins. New this week: a real two-player lobby.

sections.headingAccent: Full screen, on their own sites.

sections.heading: Recall gives the page back
body: Every game that plays on the page ends the same way. Press Escape or Recall, and the game removes what it added and restores what it changed and still owns. The page is the board, then it is the page again.

spans.text: Five of the six games run on Fizlet, Chris Cooley's micro animation and game engine for the DOM. The engine story, its bricks and its measured budgets live on

items.title: DOM VIRUS 0.46: Battlefield Blitz is playable, meet Fizlet
items.body: DOM VIRUS 0.46 marks Battlefield Blitz as playable on the coming-soon page and names the shared engine Fizlet, released as version 0.2.

items.title: Sherman Bytes: a pixel tank game that plays on your page
items.body: Drive a pixel Sherman across a live webpage: breach button bases, build cover and hold the page. Play free in your browser, then get the code.

items.title: Coming next to DOM VIRUS: Crossfire, Kaiju, Flock
items.body: Battlefield Blitz has shipped. Planned next: DOM Crossfire, DOM Kaiju, DOM Flock and multiplayer Battlefield, all on the shared Fizlet engine.
